title: Reunion, Welcoming Trouble, Privilege
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of the Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of embracing imperfection and uncertainty in mindfulness practice, particularly during difficult times. Rather than trying to achieve a specific state or overcome challenges through forceful effort, the practice involves acknowledging and working with one's own struggles and limitations. By doing so, we can cultivate awareness, balance, and compassion in our daily lives, even if it means taking small steps towards greater mindfulness and connection with ourselves and others.

Really give yourself to the walking.
It's amazing that the body knows how to do all that, took you a while to learn how, back when.
You can feel, right, the lifting and shifting of the foot and the leg.

The inhale is a feeling of lifting, with the inhale an invitation to the foot to lift and move forward in the air.

If you didn't follow through on the exhale, the foot lowers, you come back to the earth, return to balance.

Invite and allow the Buddha.
